President Murmu Urges Students to Drive India's 'Viksit Bharat' Vision

President Droupadi Murmu has called upon students to play a leading role in achieving India's goal of becoming a developed nation ('Viksit Bharat') by 2047. She emphasized the importance of education and foundational learning in the classroom as crucial elements for this national aspiration. The President's message highlights the role of the youth in shaping the country's future progress.
